propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inlined as conditionals in runner.py:268, requiring a new branch for each provider and scattering provider knowledge across the runner

httpx.AsyncClient teardown has no mechanism in pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook signature, forcing ad-hoc cleanup via runner.py:446-452 finally blocks that becomes unmaintainable with multiple providers
ProviderSession must own the lifecycle of all closeables (httpx clients) created by provider builders and close them all on context manager exit, supporting both success and exception paths

The anthropic provider builder must unpack the (model, client) tuple from _build_retrying_anthropic_model, register the client with the session, and return only the provider to match the factory signature

Tests importing _build_retrying_anthropic_model must be updated to import from rebar.llm.anthropic_model instead of rebar.llm.runner, and an unknown provider name must raise LLMConfigError with registered provider names
